terms.name: deliveredObjectiveValue
terms.description: objectiveValue of every entity that delivers

terms.name: amplification
terms.description: delivered value scaled by available amplifiers

terms.name: riskPenalty
terms.description: risk x protectionNeed for entities whose protectors are unavailable

terms.name: conflictPenalty
terms.description: mutual degradation between simultaneously delivering conflicting entities

objectiveModel.deliveryRule: available AND all depends satisfied (directly or via a delivering substitute) AND effectiveCapacity >= demand
objectiveModel.capacityRule: baseCapacity + sum(supports from delivering suppliers) - sum(inhibits from delivering inhibitors)
objectiveModel.fixedPointResolution: iterate delivery to convergence, bounded by entity count

effects.BYPASS: every substitutes relation naming this entity becomes available

consequenceModel.purity: clone-then-edit; the source world is never mutated
consequenceModel.costRule: ACTION_UTILITY = U(after) - U(before) - restorationCost of the target (HOLD costs 0)
consequenceModel.tieRule: ties in ACTION_UTILITY are broken by ascending canonical action key, and every tie is recorded
